form.descNew: Fill in all of the employee's information
form.autoCodeHint: Generated automatically: first initial + last 5 digits of the DNI (e.g. J00731).
form.payTypeDefaultAdminFloor: Company default (Legacy — Admin with hourly floor)
form.payTypeHelpDefault: Company default: uses the default method set in Payroll.
form.payTypeHelpFixed: Salaried: Monthly salary paid per attended day. Overtime (with premiums) is added to gross pay if both the company and the employee pay overtime.
form.payTypeHelpAdminFloor: Legacy — Admin with hourly floor: Don't use for new hires; prefer salaried per day.
form.payTypeHelpHourly: Hourly: Enter the equivalent monthly salary. The hourly rate is calculated automatically (base ÷ 240).
form.attendanceHelpRequired: Attendance required: payroll counts days with a check-in.
form.attendanceHelpExempt: Exempt: the full period is paid without punches (directors, staff without a time clock).
form.adminFloorNote: Admin with hourly floor always requires attendance. With no check-out or hours below the cap, the regular daily cap is credited (company settings).
form.hourlyNote: Hourly employees always require attendance tracking. With no punches in the period they show 0 hours in payroll so you can adjust them manually.
form.monthlyEquivalentWarning: Please enter the equivalent monthly salary. The system will calculate the hourly rate automatically.
form.frequencyHelp: If empty, the company setting is used (Layer 2).
form.overtimeHelpYes: Yes: eligible — if the company setting "Pay overtime" is on, overtime is added to gross pay (salaried and hourly).
form.overtimeHelpNo: No: overtime can be recorded in attendance, but it doesn't affect this employee's gross pay.
form.reasonRequiredHint: Required if the status isn't Active.
form.addressPlaceholder: Calle Principal #123, Colonia Los Laureles, Tegucigalpa, Honduras
form.profilePhotoReplace: Upload a new profile photo to replace the current one
form.profilePhotoLater: You can add a profile photo after creating the employee
